# Matt Sim (@RVAClassic): Binance Blockchain Week Bangkok

> Independent creator page. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Binance.

Matt Sim (@RVAClassic) is offering content sponsorship around Binance Blockchain Week. The main event is 28 to 29 Nov 2026 at QSNCC, Bangkok. Side events run 27 to 30 Nov 2026. He films on the ground and is looking for one Feature ($500) and one Spotlight ($250): $750 in total support for the week.

Page: https://binanceweek.rvaclassic.xyz/

## What he can film

Short-form video, X posts or a short thread, and a simple event recap or mention, shot on the ground at the main conference or at a side event. He will not invent claims about a product, and he will not frame the work as a token promotion.

## Packages

- Spotlight ($250): 1 short video (about 15-60s) filmed at your booth, stage, or side event, plus 1 X post from @RVAClassic. Usage: You may repost or embed the finished pieces, with credit. When: Filmed 27 to 30 Nov 2026 (Asia/Bangkok). Delivered within 72 hours of filming.
- Feature ($500): 2 short videos, 1 X thread (or a longer recap post), and a mention in an event recap. Usage: Same, plus I can supply the raw clip on request. When: Filmed 27 to 30 Nov 2026 (Asia/Bangkok). Delivered within 72 hours of filming.

The goal is one of each, $750 for the week. A custom brief is fine if it stays in this range, and two Spotlight packages with two teams also work if a single $500 Feature is more than you need.

What is not included: guaranteed view counts, token or trading calls, or any post that goes out before you have seen the draft if you want a review.

## How it works

1. You pick Spotlight ($250) or Feature ($500), or a small custom brief.
2. We agree the filming window (your booth, side event, or both) and any review preference.
3. He films during 27 to 30 Nov 2026 and sends drafts, then final files, within 72 hours.
4. Payment details can be agreed in writing before filming. Nothing is posted until the draft is approved if you want a review.

## About

Matt Sim is the founder of Operator Uplift, a Solana commitment app where people put down a refundable commitment deposit and submit AI-checked daily proof. It has 7,150+ accounts and is live in the Solana Mobile Seeker dApp Store as a private ecosystem beta.

- 9,417 followers on X. Figures pulled Nov 23, 2026.
- 19 hackathon prize finishes in one year and 900+ events attended in one year.
- 13 years in esports content and competing.
- Door-to-door sales background ($1M+ in sales).
- Operator Uplift: https://operatoruplift.com/
- Portfolio: https://rvaclassic.xyz/
